speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Put thy feet in motion, Nick. Do not plant thy heels. Walk while thou speakest. A princess does not stand rigid to show she has conned the lesson.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: If I walk, Master Phillips, I lose the place on the roll where the clause turns.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then leave the roll in thy left hand, and look at the window-post. Cold parlour, and we will use it.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I can walk it. See me from the chimney to the door.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nobody bade thee gallop, Sam.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I am at the door, and the sentence is not done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou art at the door, Sam, and the line is still in the room. Stand by the settle and let Nick take the floor.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick. From the middle of it. Walking slow. Do not lock thy knees.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hold. Thou hadst nothing left for the end of it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The stops are where the roll has them. I am faithful, and I am out of air.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the roll is wrong, and the faithfulness is mine to mend. Give me the roll.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Look where you tied the clauses, Will. You wrote them as if a grown chest were speaking them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I wrote it by the eye at the desk, not by the lungs.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: A boy has a pint of breath, Master Shakespeare. Don't make him spend it all on the first line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two stops. I will move them, and no word.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: If the stops move, I will not be made wrong for having learned the old ones.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou wilt not. I am changing my pointing, not thy labour.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: There. I can say the middle of it without making a test of the first line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the relief I wanted, and it is a practical one. Not praise.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Do I copy the new stops, or the old ones I already ran past?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The new. And thou wilt copy them sitting, Sam, until thou canst say a line without arriving early.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had him spend the breath at the start. That was my mark, not his.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will keep the pint for the answer, then.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it. I had buried the answer under my own commas.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: The room ended before I did.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The room is not the line, Sam. Sit. We are done when the two are on the roll.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are on it. I will not move a third. The afternoon is the Sins, and this is enough breath for a morning.
